newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Shanghai newspapers - April 18.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Shanghai newspapers - April 18.

text.p: Following is a summary of major political and business stories in local newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Shanghai. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy.
- SHANGHAI SECURITIES NEWS - China has set up a national state debt depository in which all investors and institutions are required to deposit their treasury debt certificates.
- Deputy mayor Zhao Qizheng says the Pudong development zone needs to improve its services with more and more foreign firms moving into the area.
- BUSINESS NEWS - Commentary says stock markets under heavy pressure to improve risk control with full standardisation of the markets still a long way off.
